label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — the insecure randomness is used to generate 'rememberMeKey' which is stored as a session cookie value and later retrieved from the cookie, making it suitable for session ID generation. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — the user-provided value from 'getValue(...)' is directly concatenated into the HTML response without proper encoding, creating a cross-site scripting vulnerability. Both alerts are exploitable on their respective paths, driving the case label to TP.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness source 'new java.util.Random().nextFloat()' used to generate rememberMeKey
User-provided value from getValue(...) concatenated directly into HTML response without encoding
